== Description ==
'''SHA-1''' is the one of the many Shadow entities found within the [[Shadow Challenge]] and the [[Alpha & Shadowpocalypse]] modifier.

== Behavior ==
'''SHA-1''' will make static and highlight some lockers purple upon spawning, and will rush to current room. After it reaches the current room, '''SHA-1''' will rebound and check all highlighted lockers, starting from the current room and slowly moving back. If the player is seen while entering/exiting a hiding spot, they will be inflicted with the shadow plague effect, causing them to lose some of their health overtime.

== Strategy & Tips ==
* [[Claustrophobia]] can attack while '''SHA-1''' active, so leave the locker when it is far from you.
* If you notice that some lockers got highlighted, look for a locker that isn't highlighted fast as possible.
* If there aren't any lockers that aren't highlighted, or all lockers in your room are highlighted, you should quickly get behind a locker or find a safe spot quickly to avoid being killed by '''SHA-1'''.
* Pay attention upon opening a door in the '''Shadow Challenge''', because there might be only 1 locker in the room and '''SHA-1''' might not have highlighted it. So if you don't notice or hear the static, '''SHA-1''' will kill you. Also try paying attention to the lockers to see which isn't highlighted, as in the '''Shadow Challenge''' the lights are purple, making hard to identify highlighted lockers.
* '''SHA-1''' can't kill you if you are not fully hidden, and he also makes [[Claustrophobia]] take longer to attack. Use this to your advantage.
* '''SHA-1''', along with [[SHA-2]]'s instakill can be avoided by dodge-rolling, use this in dire situations when no unmarked hiding spots are available! You will still be damaged as if you were being lockersniped though.
* '''SHA-1''' takes longer to reach the main room in the [[Section M]], so also use it as your advantage.

== Trivia ==
* '''SHA-1''' will not check the same lockers that the previous '''SHA-1''' checked, instead swapping and checking the lockers that were previously safe.
* If '''SHA-1''' is checking a Supply Cabinet/White Cabinet, it will break it instead of just checking it.
* '''SHA-1''' can invade During any Perfection Event
* '''SHA-1'''<nowiki>'</nowiki>s highlighting not entirely random. It highlights half of the hiding spots in the current room, rounded up to a whole nearest integer.
* '''SHA-1'''  can highlight tables and check it, but it will still kill you if you hide under a table, even if it wasn't marked.
* '''SHA-1''' replaces [[A-20]] in the tutorial room if you are in [[Alpha & Shadowpocalypse]].
* If '''SHA-1''' marks a locker broken (either by a player breaking a Supply Cabinet or [[SHA-140]] breaking it), it will not check it, leaving that locker marked forever.
